summary: Birding tower in Perry Lakes Park, AL: a 100-ft Aermotor MC-39 fire tower moved and rebuilt by Rural Studio students in 2005; open to visitors in daylight.

facts.design: 100' Aermotor MC-39 steel tower, rebuilt without its 7'x7' cab as an open birding tower
facts.agency: Perry County Commission administers the park (per NHLR); tower donated by the Alabama Forestry Commission

visit.trail_note: From the park entrance off AL-175, follow the dirt road through the gate; an open-air stairway climbs to the top

notes_for_editor: Origin unverified: the Rumley Lookout / Sumter County / CCC origin appears only on the NHLR page; no other source read names it. Build year conflict: NHLR field says 1936, NHLR description says late 1930s. Price conflict: Metropolis says the Forestry Commission would give the tower for a dollar; Ruth Arts says a team bought it for $10. Judson College is named only by NHLR; Metropolis and Ruth Arts credit only the Rural Studio. Start date: Metropolis says the park was ready for a student team in 2004; NHLR dates the move and restoration to 2005. Record kind 'unknown' could be 'tower' per the register; not changed, since it is incomplete rather than wrong. Search summaries about Rumley and Judson were not used. Worth asking Perry County or the Alabama Forestry Commission for the tower's original site.
